pages.title: Rite of Repose
pages.text: The Oath denies its bearers sleep. $(l)Wakeful Doom$() follows the Branded to every bed.$(br2)The $(l)Rite of Repose$() is a quiet altar of slate and dreaming dust. Near it, the Oath's grip loosens just enough to let a tired bearer close their eyes.

pages.title: Somnolent Dust
pages.text: Ground from Phantom membrane, amethyst, and glowstone. It glitters like an unfinished dream.

pages.title: The Altar
pages.text: Place the altar near the bed you mean to keep. It asks nothing further of you.

pages.title: Resting
pages.text: While Branded, you may sleep in any bed within $(thing)8 blocks$() of a Rite of Repose. Night, monsters, and every other rule of sleep still apply.$(br2)The altar wakes and glows blue whenever a Branded bearer stands within its reach, so you can see when you are inside its mercy.$(br2)Use the altar to be reminded of its radius.

pages.title: What It Does Not Do
pages.text: The Rite of Repose does not cleanse the brand, weaken the other curses, or touch the $(item)Oathbound Relic$() at all. It only quiets $(l)Wakeful Doom$().$(br2)To end the Oath itself, see the $(l)Rite of Severance$().
